reason: Although the subject sounds like a performance tweak, it changes core `pkg/util/chunk` internals (`chunk`, `column`, `codec`, `mutrow`, `row_in_disk`) in addition to join probe code. `chunk` is a central executor runtime structure, so preallocation and append-path changes can hide high-impact correctness bugs such as row corruption, panic/OOM behavior changes, or codec/spill inconsistencies across many executor paths. That makes this PR central and risky enough for a 20-40 minute deep review.
